title: The support chat widget puts supabase-js in the first-load JS of every public marketing, help and discover page

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, seo-cwv finder). components/chat/support-chat-widget.tsx imports @/lib/supabase/client statically and calls createClient().auth.getSession() on mount; use-support-chat.ts and lib/realtime/use-typing.ts import it statically too; app/(marketing)/layout.tsx, app/(help)/layout.tsx and app/discover/layout.tsx render the widget statically. components/layout/marketing-header.tsx:73-95 records why supabase was made lazy there (GoTrue, Postgrest, Realtime and Storage, 222KB raw / ~57KB gzip, in every public page's initial bundle) and the widget brings it back; OWN-052 confirmed the widget is in the RSC payload on /what-is-frequency. THE FIX: a components/chat/support-chat-launcher.tsx ('use client') that renders only the launcher button and loads the panel with dynamic(() => import('./support-chat-widget'), { ssr: false }) on first click or requestIdleCallback; point the three layouts at it; inside the widget, lazy-import the supabase client the way marketing-header.tsx does; add '@supabase/supabase-js' to HEAVY_CLIENT_MODULES in scripts/check-shell-weight.mjs so the gate catches a return. Measure with check:shell-weight before and after.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const hit=["app/(marketing)/layout.tsx","app/(help)/layout.tsx","app/discover/layout.tsx"].filter((p)=>fs.existsSync(p)&&/from \x27@\/components\/chat\/support-chat-widget\x27/.test(fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8")));if(hit.length){console.error("SCAN-674: "+hit.join(", ")+" import the support chat widget statically, which puts supabase-js (about 57KB gzip) in the first-load JS of every public marketing, help and discover page, the exact weight marketing-header.tsx records removing.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Measures the consequence; fails until the fix lands.
